_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a model sheet of a man drawn with deliberate neutrality, labeled JULIAN: a pleasant well-dressed man with nothing in his face on purpose, shown three ways the strip allows: a good gray coat hanging on a hook with no one in it, a small printed holiday-card photograph of his face beside a woman's, and once in person in linen at a cedar-and-glass pavilion, kind and blank. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
